g.title: start
g.text: Parse Config · select ToolRunner · install signal watcher

g.title: open
g.text: Acquire state-directory lock → open / migrate SQLite
Resolve environment token or persisted token

g.title: retire
g.text: Drop active non-Reporting jobs from older versions
Retain report history and pinned Reporting delivery

g.title: fork
g.text: Start optional HTTP task + three supervised futures
Shared store, boot configuration and ToolRunner

g.title: signal
g.text: Scheduled in-flight job drains; HTTP connections are not joined
Fatal supervised-loop error can terminate the daemon

g.title: run
g.text: Await this job before next claim

g.title: request
g.text: Anonymous GET: lists / lazy detail / evidence
Task per connection; serving failure is logged
